title: 使用电车带一名船员到空间站二层后返回，飞船不再停靠，角色未回到一层，游戏软锁。
description: 使用电车带一名船员到空间站二层后返回，飞船不再停靠，角色未回到一层，游戏软锁。
evidence: I take the tram on one crewmember to level 2 of the station, do my stuff, take the tram back, my ship is no longer docked, my character has not traveled back to level 1, and the game is softlocked.
